mechanism: Cenobamate is a CYP3A4 and CYP2C19 inducer that may increase iron metabolism and reduce ferrous sulfate bioavailability; ferrous sulfate may also chelate cenobamate or affect its absorption.
action: Monitor for signs of iron deficiency anemia and cenobamate efficacy; consider increased iron supplementation dosing and separate administration timing by 2+ hours; obtain baseline and periodic iron studies.
